title: Nepal Reaffirms 'One China Principle', Pledges Not to Let Territory Be Used Against China - Ratopati
description: Nepal Reaffirms 'One China Principle', Pledges Not to Let Territory Be Used Against China  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai has reaffirmed that Nepal is firm on the 'One China Principle' and pledged again not to let Nepali territory be used against China's interests.

He stated that diplomatic relations between Nepal and China are based on the principles of Panchasheel, good neighborliness, mutual partnership, cooperation, equality, and respect for each other's feelings and sensitivities.

Speaking at a program organized here on Thursday to mark the 71st anniversary of diplomatic relations between Nepal and China and the award ceremony of the 2026 Nepal-China Friendship Short Video Competition, Foreign Secretary Rai said that this anniversary is not just a sequence in our diplomatic calendar but a testament to a lasting relationship.

Foreign Secretary Rai mentioned that over the past seven decades, bilateral relations have expanded from traditional relations and cultural exchanges to broad partnerships for shared prosperity.

According to him, high-level visits and exchanges at various levels have injected dynamism and vitality into all aspects of Nepal-China relations, enhancing friendship. He noted that along with bilateral relations, Nepal and China have shown a strong commitment to multilateralism for a rules-based global order and have been cooperating on issues of common interest in various multilateral forums.

He clarified that as a good friend and close neighbor, Nepal is proud of the remarkable economic development achieved by China and wishes to learn from it and deepen Nepal's economic cooperation with the thriving Chinese economy.

Secretary Rai stated that in the past seven decades, trade, investment, infrastructure development, tourism, education, culture, and people-to-people relations between Nepal and China have expanded significantly, and Nepal will give importance to the Trans-Himalayan Multi-dimensional Connectivity Network and its early implementation.

On the occasion, Chinese Ambassador Chang Mao Ming said that since the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries, regardless of how much the international landscape has changed, they have respected, trusted, and supported each other, and have stood together in good times and bad as good neighbors, good friends, and good partners.

The Chinese Ambassador stated that since the formation of the new government in Nepal, political mutual trust between Nepal and China has deepened, and high-level 'Belt and Road Cooperation' is moving forward with concrete results.

Ambassador Mao Ming mentioned that new progress has been made in areas such as trade and economy, infrastructure, connectivity, energy, agriculture, education, health, and tourism, and that a large number of Chinese tourists are coming to see the unparalleled beauty of Nepal. Ambassador Mao Ming said that these ordinary but warm exchanges between the peoples of the two countries are the real foundation of today's Nepal-China relationship.

Ambassador Mao Ming recalled that the state visit of Chinese President Xi Jinping to Nepal in 2019 elevated the relationship between the two countries to the level of 'Strategic Partnership for Development and Prosperity'.

Ambassador Mao Ming expressed the view that China has always followed the path of peaceful development and holds the belief that all countries, regardless of their size, strength, or economic status, should respect each other, be treated equally, and coexist peacefully.

He informed that China is ready to further advance the relationship between the two countries based on mutual respect and mutual benefit, implement the important agreements reached between the two countries, and move forward in building a community of shared future between Nepal and China.

Ambassador Mao Ming expressed happiness, stating that in the digital age, short audio-visual content can transcend the boundaries of language, distance, and culture to reach a wide audience in just a few seconds.

He praised that a large number of videos were received for this year's Nepal-China Friendship Short Video Competition, and the contestants captured various aspects of Nepal-China relations and the beautiful scenery of the two countries.

Stating that emotions and intimacy are attached to audio-visual content, he said that the Nepal-China relationship is not just a political consensus written in diplomatic documents but is also alive in the extensive cooperation, exchanges, and visits between the peoples of the two countries.

At the program, the winners of the Nepal-China Friendship Short Video Competition were awarded and honored. Dipesh Syangdan received the first prize along with Rs 50,000. Leaders from various political parties, diplomats, businessmen, and individuals from other sectors were present on the occasion.
translated:
काठमांडू। विदेश सचिव अमृत बहादुर राय नेपाल ‘एक चीन सिद्धान्त’ पर दृढ़ता के पुष्टि करैत फेर सँ प्रतिज्ञा केने छथि जे नेपाली क्षेत्र के चीन के हित के विरुद्ध उपयोग नहि होमय देब।

ओ नेपाल आ चीन के बीच कूटनीतिक संबंध पंचशील, नीक पड़ोसी, आपसी साझेदारी, सहयोग, समानता, आ एक दोसर के भावना आ संवेदना के सम्मान के सिद्धांत पर आधारित अछि से बतौलनि ।

नेपाल चीन के बीच कूटनीतिक सम्बन्ध के ७१ वीं वर्षगांठ आ २०२६ के नेपाल-चीन मैत्री लघु वीडियो प्रतियोगिता के पुरस्कार समारोह के अवसर पर गुरुवार के यहाँ आयोजित कार्यक्रम में विदेश सचिव राय कहलकै कि ई वर्षगांठ खाली हमरा सब के कूटनीतिक कैलेंडर के क्रम नै बल्कि स्थायी संबंध के गवाह छै ।

विदेश सचिव राय न॑ उल्लेख करलकै कि पिछला सात दशक म॑ द्विपक्षीय संबंध पारंपरिक संबंध आरू सांस्कृतिक आदान-प्रदान स॑ ल॑ क॑ साझा समृद्धि लेली व्यापक साझेदारी म॑ विस्तारित होय गेलऽ छै ।

हुनकऽ अनुसार विभिन्न स्तरऽ प॑ उच्च स्तरीय भ्रमण आरू आदान-प्रदान स॑ नेपाल-चीन संबंध केरऽ सब पहलू म॑ गतिशीलता आरू जीवंतता के इंजेक्शन लगैलऽ गेलऽ छै, जेकरा स॑ दोस्ती बढ़ी गेलऽ छै । द्विपक्षीय संबंध के साथ-साथ नेपाल आरू चीन न॑ नियम आधारित वैश्विक व्यवस्था लेली बहुपक्षीयता के प्रति मजबूत प्रतिबद्धता देखैलकै आरू विभिन्न बहुपक्षीय मंचऽ म॑ साझा हित के मुद्दा प॑ सहयोग करी रहलऽ छै ।

ओ स्पष्ट केलनि जे एकटा नीक मित्र आ घनिष्ठ पड़ोसी के रूप मे नेपाल चीन द्वारा प्राप्त उल्लेखनीय आर्थिक विकास पर गर्व करैत अछि आ एहि सँ सीख लेबय चाहैत अछि आ चीन के समृद्ध अर्थव्यवस्था के संग नेपाल के आर्थिक सहयोग के गहरा करय चाहैत अछि।

सचिव राय कहलनि जे, विगत सात दशक मे नेपाल आ चीन के बीच व्यापार, निवेश, बुनियादी ढांचा विकास, पर्यटन, शिक्षा, संस्कृति, आ जन-जन संबंध मे काफी विस्तार भेल अछि, आ नेपाल ट्रांस-हिमालयन बहुआयामी संपर्क संजाल आ एकर शीघ्र क्रियान्वयन के महत्व देत।

ई अवसर प॑ चीन केरऽ राजदूत चांग माओ मिंग न॑ कहलकै कि जब॑ स॑ दोनों देशऽ के बीच कूटनीतिक संबंध स्थापित होय गेलऽ छै, चाहे अंतरराष्ट्रीय परिदृश्य म॑ कतनी भी बदलाव आबी गेलऽ छै, दोनों देशऽ न॑ एक-दूसरा के सम्मान, भरोसा, आरू साथ देल॑ छै, आरू अच्छा-बेजाय समय म॑ अच्छा पड़ोसी, अच्छा दोस्त, आरू अच्छा साथी के रूप म॑ एक साथ खड़ा होय गेलऽ छै ।

चीन के राजदूत नेपाल में नव सरकार के गठन के बाद स नेपाल आ चीन के बीच राजनीतिक आपसी विश्वास गहरा भ गेल अछि, आ उच्च स्तरीय ‘बेल्ट एंड रोड सहयोग’ ठोस परिणाम के संग आगू बढ़ि रहल अछि।

राजदूत माओ मिंग व्यापार आ अर्थव्यवस्था, बुनियादी ढांचा, संपर्क, ऊर्जा, कृषि, शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, आ पर्यटन जेहन क्षेत्र मे नव प्रगति भेल आ नेपालक बेजोड़ सौन्दर्य देखबा लेल पैघ संख्या मे चीनी पर्यटक आबि रहल छथि से उल्लेख केलनि। राजदूत माओ मिंग कहलनि जे, दुनू देशक जनताक बीच ई साधारण मुदा गर्मजोशी सँ आदान-प्रदान आजुक नेपाल-चीन संबंधक असली आधार अछि।

राजदूत माओ मिंग न॑ स्मरण करलकै कि २०१९ म॑ चीन केरऽ राष्ट्रपति शी जिनपिंग केरऽ नेपाल केरऽ राज्य यात्रा स॑ दूनू देशऽ के बीच के संबंध क॑ ‘विकास आरू समृद्धि लेली रणनीतिक साझेदारी’ के स्तर प॑ पहुँचैलऽ गेलै ।

राजदूत माओ मिंग न॑ ई विचार व्यक्त करलकै कि चीन हमेशा स॑ शांतिपूर्ण विकास के रास्ता प॑ चलै छै आरू ओकरऽ ई विश्वास छै कि सब देश क॑ चाहे ओकरऽ आकार, ताकत या आर्थिक स्थिति केतना भी होय, एक-दूसरा के सम्मान करना चाहियऽ, समान व्यवहार करलऽ जाय आरू शांतिपूर्ण तरीका स॑ सह-अस्तित्व म॑ रहना चाहियऽ ।

ओ जानकारी देलनि जे चीन आपसी सम्मान आ आपसी लाभ के आधार पर दुनू देश के बीच संबंध के आओर आगू बढ़ेबा लेल, दुनू देश के बीच भेल महत्वपूर्ण समझौता के लागू करय लेल, आ नेपाल आ चीन के बीच साझा भविष्य के समुदाय के निर्माण मे आगू बढ़य लेल तैयार अछि।

राजदूत माओ मिंग न॑ खुशी व्यक्त करतें हुअ॑ कहलकै कि डिजिटल युग म॑ छोटऽ-छोटऽ दृश्य-श्रव्य सामग्री भाषा, दूरी, आरू संस्कृति के सीमा क॑ पार करी क॑ महज कुछ सेकंड म॑ ही व्यापक दर्शक वर्ग तलक पहुँची सकै छै ।

ओ प्रशंसा केलनि जे एहि बेरक नेपाल-चीन मैत्री लघु वीडियो प्रतियोगिता लेल पैघ संख्या मे वीडियो भेटल, आ प्रतियोगी लोकनि नेपाल-चीन संबंधक विभिन्न पक्ष आ दुनू देशक सुन्दर दृश्य केँ कैप्चर केलनि।

श्रव्य-दृश्य सामग्री सँ भाव आ आत्मीयता जुड़ल कहैत ओ कहलनि जे नेपाल-चीन संबंध मात्र कूटनीतिक दस्तावेज मे लिखल राजनीतिक सहमति नहि अपितु दुनू देशक जनताक बीच व्यापक सहयोग, आदान-प्रदान, आ यात्रा मे सेहो जीवित अछि।

कार्यक्रम मे नेपाल-चीन मैत्री लघु वीडियो प्रतियोगिता के विजेता के पुरस्कृत आ सम्मानित कायल गेल। दिपेश स्यांगदान कए 50 हजार टका क संग प्रथम पुरस्कार भेटल। एहि अवसर पर विभिन्न राजनीतिक दलक नेता, राजनयिक, व्यापारी, आ अन्य क्षेत्रक व्यक्ति उपस्थित छलाह ।

title: Cybercrime complaints top 20,000 in Nepal, but only 155 arrests made - The Himalayan Times
description: Cybercrime complaints top 20,000 in Nepal, but only 155 arrests made  The Himalayan Times
publisher.title: The Himalayan Times
full_article:
KATHMANDU, AUGUST 14

Nepal Police registered 20,526 cybercrime-related complaints in fiscal year 2082/83 (mid-July 2025 to mid-July 2026), while only 161 cases were filed and 155 people arrested during the same period, according to the Central Police Newsroom.

Related Articles Case filed against eight individuals in Bal Mandir case; three arrested, five absconding Cybercrime cases explode in Dhading as complaints jump more than sixfold

The figure marks an increase from the previous two fiscal years; 18,926 complaints were registered in FY 2081/82 and 19,730 in FY 2080/81.

Among the complaints registered, misuse of Facebook and Messenger accounted for the largest share at 7,123, followed by TikTok at 6,776, WhatsApp at 3,105, Telegram at 1,031 and Instagram at 628. Email-related complaints numbered 114, alongside smaller numbers involving Viber (21), Imo (38), YouTube (64), WeChat (14), Twitter (11) and Google (11). Complaints linked to eSewa, Khalti, bank accounts and SMS totalled 744, while institution-related complaints numbered 846.

Cyber Bureau spokesperson, Police Senior Superintendent Dilip Kumar Giri, said misuse of social media has grown alongside its use. He said complaint patterns over the past two fiscal years show a rise in scams involving fraudsters posing as bank or wallet company representatives to access victims' accounts, as well as fraud through fake gift, lottery and parcel offers, romance scams, false promises of foreign employment, fake online job offers circulated via Telegram, WhatsApp and Instagram, and fraud disguised as online shopping.

Police said the changing nature of technology misuse has made criminal investigation increasingly challenging. The Cyber Bureau was established by a Government of Nepal decision on June 8, 2018, to prevent and investigate technology-related crime. Police said the bureau has since been strengthened with additional technological capacity, alongside programmes to build police personnel's cyber-crime and security expertise and to raise public awareness of cyber security.

Those involved in cybercrime are prosecuted under the Electronic Transactions Act, 2063 BS.

title: Sher Bahadur Deuba Returns to Nepal After Five Months of Medical Treatment - Daily Pioneer
description: Sher Bahadur Deuba Returns to Nepal After Five Months of Medical Treatment  Daily Pioneer
publisher.title: Daily Pioneer
full_article:
Former prime minister Sher Bahadur Deuba returned to Nepal on Thursday after spending more than five months abroad for medical treatment following injuries sustained during the Gen Z protests last year.

Deuba and his wife, former foreign minister Arzu Rana Deuba, were seriously injured during violent protests on September 9, 2025, when anti-Government demonstrations led by the Gen Z movement swept across Nepal and resulted in the fall of the KP Sharma Oli Government. The couple travelled to Singapore in February for medical treatment. Deuba, who is also the former president of Nepali Congress (NC), reportedly stayed in Hong Kong for a brief period as well.

According to his party leaders, Deuba landed at Tribhuvan International Airport here in the afternoon after completing his medical treatment.

The whereabouts of Rana remain unclear. Deuba was received at the airport by senior NC leaders, including Purna Bahadur Khadka, Shashanka Koirala,

Prakash Man Singh and Bimalendra Nidhi, among others. Hundreds of party activists from across the country gathered near the airport to welcome the former prime minister, cheering as he arrived.

In an appeal issued after his arrival, Deuba said the mountains, green hills and vast plains of the Tarai had called him back home.

The former premier said he has returned not as a leader but as a lifelong citizen of the nation, ready to serve with humility, dedication, and love.

Deuba, 80, has served as Nepal’s prime minister five times between 1995 and 2022 and is a veteran NC leader. He became party president in 2016 and was re-elected in 2021. During the Gen Z protest, Deuba was not holding any ministerial position. He was serving as a Member of Parliament and the party president.

publisher.title: India Today
full_article:
After years of continued diabolical terror plots in India, Pakistan now seems to be attempting to disturb peace in the neighbouring Nepal as the Inter-Services Intelligence (ISI) is suspected to have played a covert role in the communal riots that recently erupted in Sunsari district along the India border, exclusive details accessed by India Today show.

Investigators are examining evidence that illegal funds were routed into Nepal through networks linked to Pakistan, Turkey and Qatar. The findings form part of a preliminary report submitted by Nepal’s National Investigation Department (NID) to the Ministry of Home Affairs.

The unrest began on July 26 in Kaptanganj in Sunsari district, which borders Bihar and is an important transit corridor between India and Nepal.

Authorities said clashes broke out between two communities during separate religious programmes over the use of loudspeakers and the display of religious flags.

Police intervention and subsequent firing left at least one person dead and more than a dozen people injured, including security personnel, while tensions later spread to other districts in Nepal’s southern Terai region.

According to the NID report, a Turkey-based cleric of Pakistani origin, Mohammad Ilyas Ghuman, had stayed for several days at a mosque in Dewanganj before the violence.

He was accompanied by Mufti Abu Bakr Qasmi, the Imam of Kathmandu’s Jama Masjid. Investigators are examining whether their presence and meetings with local clerics in border districts had any connection with the subsequent unrest.

The report says Islamic flags had been erected around a vacant plot associated with a Shiva temple in Kaptanganj during Muharram observances. Local Hindu residents had reportedly sought their removal for weeks before the violence.

On the night before a Shravan pilgrimage ritual, a group of Kanwariyas was allegedly attacked near a madrasa, triggering wider clashes. The NID has also identified a local electricity department employee, Naseem Ansari, as the person who disconnected power supply in the area shortly before the attack.

Security forces later opened fire while attempting to control the violence. Official figures indicate more than a dozen people were injured, while local residents have claimed the number was higher.

The NID report describes Ghuman as a prominent member of the banned Tablighi Jamaat and alleges links to organisations such as Harkat-ul-Mujahideen, Harkat-ul-Ansar and Hizbul Mujahideen, all of which are banned in India and several other countries.

Nepalese investigators are now probing whether his movements through Biratnagar, Rautahat, Nepalgunj and Kapilvastu were linked to meetings held in mosques and madrasas in those districts.

Investigators are also examining the presence of nine Bangladeshi clerics who arrived in Kathmandu from Dhaka via Kuala Lumpur on July 20 on 30-day tourist visas and later travelled through districts bordering India.

The report has revived concerns about Nepal being used as a base for activities directed against India.

Security officials note that the ISI was highly active in Nepal during the 1990s and early 2000s and that the 1999 Indian Airlines hijacking had exposed the use of Nepalese territory for anti-India operations.

Indian agencies have also flagged several recent cases involving Nepal-based networks.

These include the arrest of Nepali national Prabhat Kumar Chaurasia in Delhi in 2025 in an alleged SIM card supply module linked to the ISI, the arrest of Ansarul Miyan Ansari with sensitive military-related material, and the detention of Sheikh Salim in Nepal in connection with an alleged ISI-linked arms network.

Nepalese investigators are also reviewing the case of four Pakistani nationals arrested in Kapilvastu in April 2026, which some security officials believe may have had intelligence links.

Another area of concern for both Nepal and India is the rapid growth of mosques and madrasas in border districts.

Official Nepalese data show about 911 registered institutions in areas adjoining India, while authorities estimate that roughly 3,000 more remain unregistered along the 1,751-km open border.

Investigators say a substantial share of foreign funding originates from countries including Turkey, Qatar, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.

The preliminary intelligence findings are now expected to lead to a wider investigation into funding channels, cross-border networks and the role of foreign clerics in Nepal’s recent communal unrest, with both Nepalese and Indian security agencies closely monitoring developments along the sensitive border belt.

रिपोर्ट स नेपाल कए भारत क खिलाफ निर्देशित गतिविधि क आधार क रूप मे उपयोग कैल जेबाक चिंता फेर स जागि गेल अछि।

सुरक्षा अधिकारी सब नोट करै छै कि आईएसआई 1990 के दशक आरू 2000 के दशक के शुरुआत के दौरान नेपाल में बहुत सक्रिय छेलै आरू 1999 के इंडियन एयरलाइंस के अपहरण के बाद भारत विरोधी अभियान के लेलऽ नेपाली इलाका के उपयोग के खुलासा होय गेलऽ छेलै ।

भारतीय एजेंसी नेपाल स्थित नेटवर्क सं जुड़ल हाल के कईटा मामला के सेहो झंडा देखा देलक अछि.

एहि मे आईएसआई सं जुड़ल कथित सिम कार्ड सप्लाई मॉड्यूल मे 2025 मे दिल्ली मे नेपाली नागरिक प्रभात कुमार चौरसिया के गिरफ्तारी, अंसारुल मियाँ अंसारी के संवेदनशील सैन्य संबंधी सामग्री के संग गिरफ्तारी, आ आईएसआई सं जुड़ल कथित हथियार संजाल के सिलसिला मे नेपाल मे शेख सलीम के हिरासत मे लेल गेल शामिल अछि.

विज्ञापन

नेपाली जांचकर्ता अप्रैल २०२६ म॑ कपिलवस्तु म॑ गिरफ्तार करलऽ गेलऽ चार पाकिस्तानी नागरिकऽ के मामला के समीक्षा भी करी रहलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ कुछ सुरक्षा अधिकारी सिनी के मानना छै कि खुफिया संबंध भी होय सकै छै ।

नेपाल आ भारत दुनूक लेल एकटा आओर चिंता के क्षेत्र अछि सीमावर्ती जिला मे मस्जिद आ मदरसा के तेजी सं बढ़ब.

नेपाली आधिकारिक आंकड़ा भारत स सटल इलाका मे करीब 911 पंजीकृत संस्था बता रहल अछि, जखन कि अधिकारी क अनुमान अछि जे 1,751 किलोमीटर क खुला सीमा पर लगभग 3,000 आओर अपंजीकृत अछि।

जांचकर्ता के कहना छै कि विदेशी फंडिंग के काफी हिस्सा तुर्की, कतार, कुवैत, सऊदी अरब आरू संयुक्त अरब अमीरात सहित देशऽ स॑ मिलै छै ।

खुफिया जानकारी केरऽ प्रारंभिक निष्कर्ष स॑ अब॑ फंडिंग चैनल, सीमा पार स॑ नेटवर्क आरू नेपाल केरऽ हाल केरऽ साम्प्रदायिक अशांति म॑ विदेशी मौलवी के भूमिका के व्यापक जांच के उम्मीद छै, जेकरा म॑ नेपाली आरू भारतीय सुरक्षा एजेंसी दोनों ही संवेदनशील सीमा पट्टी के साथ-साथ घटनाक्रम प॑ बारीकी स॑ नजर रखी रहलऽ छै ।

full_article:
Nepali youths, joined by former Gorkha soldiers and their family members, took to the streets in Nepal's Pokhara city this week, demanding Nepalese citizens be allowed to enlist as Agniveers under the Indian Army's Agnipath scheme. The enlistment of Gorkha soldiers into the Indian Army has been one of the strongest shared links between India and Nepal.

But recruitments have been paused since 2019, initially due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Nepal subsequently suspended the recruitment of Nepali youths after India introduced the Agnipath scheme in 2022, under which only up to 25 per cent of recruits are retained for permanent service after four years.

The remaining 75 per cent are discharged with a one-time lump-sum payment and do not receive pensions or other long-term career benefits.

The Nepali government had halted the recruitment, arguing that the scheme was inconsistent with the provisions of the 1947 Tripartite Agreement between India, Nepal, and Britain.

Why Nepali Youth Is Protesting

The protests in Pokhara come ahead of Indian Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth's scheduled visit to Nepal on Sunday.

With employment opportunities in Nepal limited, many young people in the Himalayan nation are interested in joining the Indian Army under the Agnipath scheme and are urging the Balendra (Balen) Shah government in Kathmandu to resume the recruitment process.

The protest march in Pokhara, a major tourism city in western Nepal, was organised by the Indian Ex-Servicemen Gorkha Brigade Nepal and was attended by former soldiers, their family members and youths who had received training to join foreign armies.

The protesters carried placards demanding the resumption of recruitment of Nepali youths under the revamped recruitment Agnipath scheme introduced by the Indian government.

The Demands

They said Nepali youths should be allowed to join the Indian Army as Agniveers rather than being compelled to seek employment in Gulf countries, according to a report by news agency IANS.

Among their key demands, which they also shared on social media, protesters asked for immediate reopening of the Agnipath recruitment process, which they said was essential to protect employment opportunities for Nepali youths and preserve the identity and tradition associated with Gurkha soldiers.

The protesters also demanded that the registration process for organisations representing former soldiers and bearing the term "ex-servicemen" not be halted. Such organisations, they said, are necessary to safeguard the dignity, rights and interests of former soldiers.

The rally, which began at Pokhara Stadium, proceeded to the District Administration Office, where the organisers submitted a memorandum to the Chief District Officer of Kaski in the presence of a large gathering.

नेपालक पोखरा शहरमे नेपाली युवक पूर्व गोरखा जवान आ हुनक परिवारक सदस्यसभ एहि सप्ताह सड़क पर उतरि भारतीय सेनाक अग्निपथ योजना अन्तर्गत नेपाली नागरिकके अग्निवीरके रुपमे भर्ती हेबाक अनुमति देबाक माँग केलक अछि । गोरखा जवान के भारतीय सेना में भर्ती भारत आ नेपाल के बीच सबस मजबूत साझा कड़ी में स एक रहल अछि।

मुदा 2019 स भर्ती रोकल गेल अछि, शुरू मे कोविड-19 महामारी क कारण। एकरऽ बाद भारत न॑ २०२२ म॑ अग्निपथ योजना शुरू करला के बाद नेपाल न॑ नेपाली युवा सिनी के भर्ती प॑ रोक लगाय देलकै, जेकरा तहत ४ साल बाद मात्र २५ प्रतिशत तलक भर्ती होय वाला क॑ स्थायी सेवा लेली बरकरार रखलऽ जाय छै ।

शेष 75 प्रतिशत कें एक बेर कें एकमुश्त भुगतान सं छुट्टी देल जायत छै आ ओकरा पेंशन या अन्य दीर्घकालिक कैरियर लाभ नहि भेटैत छै.

नेपाली सरकार भारत, नेपाल, ब्रिटेन के बीच १९४७ के त्रिपक्षीय समझौता के प्रावधान के साथ असंगत ई तर्क दैत भर्ती रोकने छल ।

नेपाली युवा विरोध कियैक क रहल अछि

भारतीय सेना प्रमुख जनरल धीरज सेठ के रविदिन नेपाल यात्रा के निर्धारित समय सं पहिने पोखरा के ई विरोध प्रदर्शन भेल अछि.

नेपाल मे रोजगार के अवसर सीमित रहला के कारण हिमालय राष्ट्र के बहुत रास युवा अग्निपथ योजना के तहत भारतीय सेना में शामिल होबय के इच्छुक छथि आ काठमांडू के बलेन्द्र (बलेन) शाह सरकार के भर्ती प्रक्रिया के फेर सं शुरू करय लेल आग्रह क रहल छथिन्ह.

पश्चिम नेपालके प्रमुख पर्यटन नगरी पोखरामे भारतीय पूर्व सैनिक गोरखा ब्रिगेड नेपालके आयोजनामे भेल विरोध मार्चमे पूर्व सैनिक, हुनकर परिवारके सदस्य आ विदेशी सेनामे भर्ती हेबाक प्रशिक्षण प्राप्त युवकसबके सहभागिता रहल छल ।

भारत सरकार द्वारा शुरू कएल गेल नवनिर्मित भर्ती अग्निपथ योजनाक अन्तर्गत नेपाली युवासभक बहाली फेर सँ शुरू करबाक माँग करय बला प्लेकार्ड ल' क' प्रदर्शनकारी छल ।

द डिमांड्स

समाचार एजेंसी आईएएनएस के रिपोर्ट के अनुसार खाड़ी देश में रोजगार के लेल मजबूर नै होबय के बजाय नेपाली युवा के अग्निवीर के रूप में भारतीय सेना में शामिल होय के अनुमति देबाक चाही।

सोशल मीडिया पर सेहो साझा कयल गेल अपन प्रमुख मांग मे प्रदर्शनकारी अग्निपथ भर्ती प्रक्रिया के तत्काल फेर सं खोलय के आग्रह केलनि, जे नेपाली युवा के रोजगार के अवसर के रक्षा आ गोरखा जवान सं जुड़ल पहचान आ परंपरा के संरक्षित करय लेल जरूरी कहल गेल अछि.

प्रदर्शनकारी न॑ ई भी मांग करलकै कि पूर्व सैनिकऽ के प्रतिनिधित्व करै वाला आरू “पूर्व सैनिक” शब्द धारण करै वाला संगठनऽ के पंजीकरण प्रक्रिया क॑ रोकलऽ नै जाय । ओ सब कहलनि जे, पूर्व सैनिक के गरिमा, अधिकार आ हित के रक्षा के लेल एहन संगठन जरूरी अछि।

पोखरा स्टेडियम स शुरू भेल रैली जिला प्रशासन कार्यालय दिस बढ़ल, जतय आयोजक सब पैघ सभा के उपस्थिति मे कास्की के मुख्य जिला अधिकारी के ज्ञापन सौंपलक।

title: Western Nepal faces 38°C heat as very heavy rain threatens hills - The Himalayan Times
description: Western Nepal faces 38°C heat as very heavy rain threatens hills  The Himalayan Times
publisher.title: The Himalayan Times
full_article:
Key Takeaways:

Dhangadhi/Nepalgunj forecast 36–38°C, Bhairahawa also up to 38°C

Very heavy rainfall likely in Karnali and Sudurpashchim hilly regions

Kathmandu cloudy with moderate rain, 28–30°C daytime

Pokhara 30–32°C with 60% chance of rain

Western Nepal is set for a sharp weather contrast on Friday, with Dhangadhi and Nepalgunj forecast to reach up to 38°C while parts of Karnali and Sudurpashchim face the possibility of very heavy rainfall.

The Meteorological Forecasting Division said generally cloudy conditions would prevail across the country, with moderate rain accompanied by thunder and lightning expected across large parts of the Himalayan, hilly and Terai regions.

Very heavy rainfall is likely at one or two places in the Himalayan and hilly regions of Karnali and Sudurpashchim provinces. Heavy rain is also possible in parts of Koshi, Bagmati, Gandaki and Lumbini provinces.

googletag.cmd.push(function() { googletag.display('div-gpt-ad-1686127029429-0'); }); googletag.cmd.push(function() { googletag.display('div-gpt-ad-1686127067910-0'); }); googletag.cmd.push(function() { googletag.display('div-gpt-ad-1686127112906-0'); });

Among the major cities, Dhangadhi and Nepalgunj are forecast to record maximum temperatures of 36–38°C, while Bhairahawa is also expected to reach 36–38°C. Janakpur could reach 35–37°C and Simara 35–37°C.

In Kathmandu, moderate rain with thunderstorms is forecast, with temperatures ranging from 28–30°C. Pokhara is expected to record 30–32°C with a 60% chance of rain.

The weather office said the monsoon is currently influencing the entire country. The monsoon low-pressure line is around its average position in the eastern parts and lies slightly north of its average position near Nepal in the western parts.

For tonight, moderate rain or snowfall with thunderstorms is possible in parts of the Himalayan and hilly regions, while heavy rainfall is likely at one or two places in the hilly regions of Bagmati, Gandaki, Karnali and Sudurpashchim.

Key temperatures: Dhangadhi/Nepalgunj 36–38°C; Bhairahawa 36–38°C; Kathmandu 28–30°C; Pokhara 30–32°C; Jomsom 23–25°C.

title: Three 'kanwariyas' from Nepal killed, 10 injured as bus rams into truck in Jharkhand - The New Indian Express
description: Three 'kanwariyas' from Nepal killed, 10 injured as bus rams into truck in Jharkhand  The New Indian Express
publisher.title: The New Indian Express
full_article:
At least three 'kanwariyas' from Nepal, including a 10-year-old boy, were killed and 10 others injured after a bus carrying pilgrims rammed into a stationary truck in Jharkhand’s Koderma district on Friday, police said.

The accident occurred at Pokhradih in the Satgawan police station area at around 4.30am, an officer said.

“At least three 'kanwariyas' were killed and 10 others were injured in the accident. The injured have been admitted to a local hospital,” Satgawan police station in-charge Bablu Kumar told PTI.

title: Umesh Pokharel elected new chair of Media Action Nepal - The Himalayan Times
description: Umesh Pokharel elected new chair of Media Action Nepal  The Himalayan Times
publisher.title: The Himalayan Times
full_article:
KATHMANDU, AUGUST 13

Media researcher Umesh Pokharel has been elected as the new chair of Media Action Nepal, following a meeting of the organisation's executive committee members in Kathmandu today.

Related Articles Investing in the next generation: A lesson for Nepal and the world The new Vice Chancellor of TU: A defining test for Nepal's higher education

Pokharel is a media activist and researcher with extensive experience in the media and development sectors. He previously served as South Asia Coordinator of the International Federation of Journalists (IFJ) and has also worked as a research consultant for DW Akademie, Germany. His background spans media research, journalism, media development, press freedom and journalists' rights, with a particular focus on South Asia.

Assuming office, he said, "I am pleased to be part of Media Action Nepal and to contribute to its mission, vision, goals and priorities, particularly in promoting freedom of expression, journalists' safety, the right to information, and media development."

Welcoming the newly elected Chair, Dr Laxman Datt Pant, Founding Chair of Media Action Nepal, expressed confidence that under Pokharel's leadership, the organisation will continue to strengthen its work across key areas of media development, press freedom, the right to information, and freedom of expression, while fostering broader cross-sector collaboration to advance a vibrant and inclusive media landscape in Nepal.

Amit Pyakurel was also appointed executive director of the organisation.

Outgoing chair Priyanka Jha extended her best wishes to the incoming leadership and expressed hope of continuing to support free press and media development in Nepal and around the world.

In the heart of Nepal's Terai plains, presented around the world as a conservation success story, animal attacks have claimed hundreds of lives. In some areas, tigers kill up to three people a month.

title: Nepali MMA prospects take centre stage across India ahead of Dhant’s Road to UFC bout - The Kathmandu Post
description: Nepali MMA prospects take centre stage across India ahead of Dhant’s Road to UFC bout  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
Nepali mixed martial arts is experiencing an unprecedented regional surge. While local combat sports fans eagerly await star fighter Rabindra Dhant’s high-stakes return at Road to UFC, three rising prospects are taking centre stage across India over the next fortnight, showcasing the expanding footprint of Nepali fighters in the regional combat scene.

The regional campaign kicks off in South India at Legacy Fighting Championship (LFC)-2, held at the Katedan Sports Complex in Hyderabad. Representing Nepal in high-stakes semi-pro bouts, Gokul Khadka and Asbeen Chhetri are scheduled to square off against Indian contenders Thushar and Adil Hussain, respectively.

The main action commences at 6pm Indian Time (6:15pm Nepali time) on Saturday.

Recognising the power of crowd energy on foreign turf, both Khadka and Chhetri have issued a passionate rallying call to the sizeable Nepali diaspora residing in and near Hyderabad, urging fans to turn out at the venue in full force and lend their support.

Khadka and Chhetri have travelled together for the same promotions in India before as well.

Khadka had defeated Roshan Jameeruddin by submission, and Chhetri knocked out Indresh Uniyal at Elite Contender Series-II in Kolkata in June. Khadka had also defeated Navneet Singh Brijwal at ECS-I in March as well.

A week following the Hyderabad card, the spotlight shifts thousands of kilometres northeast to Arunachal Pradesh for Aturto 4.2—Flyweight Grand Prix, hosted at the Artisan Cum Handicrafts Exhibition Centre in Chimpu, Itanagar.

Making his highly anticipated professional debut on the card is Rahul Hamal Thakuri, known inside the cage as “The Mechanic” and “The Bad Boy”.

Thakuri faces a trial by fire against India’s Darren Kharshandy. Holding a 1-2 professional record, Kharshandy brings valuable cage experience to the bout and will be looking to derail the Nepali debutant’s momentum.

“This is my first pro debut fight at Aturto,” Thakuri said in a video message on July 15 while signing the contract. “I am coming to fight. See you on August 22.”

These regional outings represent a vital bridge for Nepal’s blossoming combat sports ecosystem. The grit and experience gained by Khadka, Chhetri and Thakuri on the Indian circuit provide crucial momentum for the nation's fight community just as Dhant prepares for his historic bid on the international stage two weeks later.

क्षेत्रीय अभियान दक्षिण भारत म॑ हैदराबाद केरऽ कटेडन स्पोर्ट्स कॉम्प्लेक्स म॑ आयोजित लेगेसी फाइटिंग चैंपियनशिप (एलएफसी)-२ स॑ शुरू होय रहलऽ छै । उच्च दांव वाला सेमी प्रो मुकाबला मे नेपाल के प्रतिनिधित्व करय वाला गोकुल खड्का आओर असबीन क्षेत्री के क्रमशः भारतीय दावेदार थुशर आओर आदिल हुसैन के खिलाफ मुकाबला करय के अछि.

मुख्य क्रिया शनिदिन भारतीय समय (नेपाली समय स साँझ ६:१५ बजे) सँ प्रारंभ होइत अछि ।

विदेशी मैदान पर भीड़ ऊर्जा केरऽ शक्ति क॑ पहचानी क॑ खड्का आरू क्षेत्री दोनों न॑ हैदराबाद आरू ओकरऽ नजदीक रह॑ वाला बड़ऽ नेपाली प्रवासी क॑ भावुक जुटान के आह्वान जारी करी क॑ प्रशंसकऽ स॑ आग्रह करलकै कि वू आयोजन स्थल प॑ पूरा ताकत स॑ आबी क॑ अपनऽ समर्थन दै ।

खडका आ क्षेत्री एहि सं पहिने सेहो भारत मे ओही प्रचार के लेल एक संग यात्रा केने छथिन्ह.

खड्का न॑ रोशन जमेरुद्दीन क॑ सबमिशन स॑ हरा देल॑ छेलै, आरू क्षेत्री न॑ जून म॑ कोलकाता म॑ एलिट कंटेंडर सीरीज-II म॑ इंद्रेश उनियाल क॑ हरा देलकै । खड्का मार्च म॑ भी ईसीएस-आई म॑ नवनीत सिंह बृजवाल क॑ भी हरा चुकलऽ छेलै ।

हैदराबाद कार्ड के एक सप्ताह बाद इटानगर के चिंपू स्थित कारीगर सह हस्तशिल्प प्रदर्शनी केंद्र में आयोजित अतुर्टो 4.2—फ्लाईवेट ग्रांड प्रिक्स के लेल हजारों किलोमीटर उत्तर-पूर्व में अरुणाचल प्रदेश में सुर्खी आबि गेल अछि.

कार्ड प॑ अपनऽ बहुप्रतीक्षित प्रोफेशनल डेब्यू करी रहलऽ छै राहुल हमल ठकुरी, जेकरा पिंजरा के भीतर “द मैकेनिक” आरू “द बैड बॉय” के नाम स॑ जानलऽ जाय छै ।

ठकुरी क॑ भारत केरऽ डैरेन खरशंडी के खिलाफ गोलीबारी के मुकदमा के सामना करना पड़॑ छै । १-२ के प्रोफेशनल रिकॉर्ड रखै वाला खरशंडी ई मुकाबला म॑ कीमती पिंजरा के अनुभव लानै छै आरू नेपाली नवोदित खिलाड़ी केरऽ गति क॑ पटरी स॑ उतारै के कोशिश करतै ।

ठकुरी न॑ १५ जुलाई क॑ अनुबंध प॑ हस्ताक्षर करतें हुअ॑ एगो वीडियो मैसेज म॑ कहलकै कि अतुर्टो म॑ हमरऽ ई पहलऽ प्रो डेब्यू मुकाबला छेकै । “हम लड़य आबि रहल छी, 22 अगस्त केँ भेंट होयत।”

ई क्षेत्रीय आउटिंग नेपाल केरऽ खिललऽ युद्ध खेल पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र लेली एगो महत्वपूर्ण सेतु के प्रतिनिधित्व करै छै । भारतीय सर्किट प॑ खडका, क्षेत्री आरू ठकुरी क॑ मिललऽ ग्रिट आरू अनुभव राष्ट्र केरऽ लड़ाकू समुदाय लेली महत्वपूर्ण गति प्रदान करै छै ठीक वैसने जइसे धनत दू सप्ताह बाद अंतरराष्ट्रीय मंच प॑ अपनऽ ऐतिहासिक बोली के तैयारी करै छै ।

Three pilgrims from Nepal, including a 10-year-old boy and an elderly couple, were killed and around 15 others injured when their bus rammed into a parked truck on the Deoghar-Nawada main road near Pokhardiha in Koderma district early Friday.Police suspect the bus driver dozed off at the wheel, leading to the high-speed collision. The bus was carrying nearly 45 devotees from Dumariya and Potiyahi villages in Nepal to Rajgir after visits to Deoghar and Basukinath.Injured passenger Anshu Chaudhary toldthe group began its pilgrimage on Sunday and reached Deoghar on Tuesday. The devotees offered prayers at Basukinath on Wednesday, stayed there overnight and left for Rajgir on Thursday night.The impact woke nearby residents, who rushed to the spot and joined police in rescue operations. Satgawan police station officer in-charge Bablu Kumar Singh reached the site with a team. Locals and police personnel worked for hours to pull passengers out from the mangled bus.The injured were taken in police vehicles to a local community health centre for emergency treatment, while those in critical condition were shifted to Koderma Sadar Hospital.Shivam Kumar, 10, died during treatment at the CHC. Sundar Bala, 60, and her husband Nawal Kishore, 65, died while being taken to Sadar Hospital.Civil surgeon Dr Anil Kumar said the remaining injured pilgrims were discharged after treatment. Police handed over the bodies to their families, seized the bus and registered a case. An investigation is under way to determine the exact cause of the crash.

title: Nepal says it may have lost treaty papers marking border with India - Yahoo News Singapore
description: Nepal says it may have lost treaty papers marking border with India  Yahoo News Singapore
publisher.title: Yahoo News Singapore
full_article:
Nepal says it cannot locate the original documents of the treaty establishing its boundary with India, complicating the border dispute between the neighbouring South Asian nations.

Foreign minister Shisir Khanal told the parliament that Nepal did not "have clear information on whether we possess the official treaty documents".

The Sugauli Treaty was signed in 1816 after the British East India Company defeated the Kingdom of Nepal in the Anglo-Nepalese War. The treaty significantly reduced Nepal's territory by compelling the Himalayan kingdom to give up swathes of land in the west and the east that would eventually become part of independent India.

"There are records showing that some documents related to certain treaties are kept at the National Archives. But we don't have clear information as to whether those are the actual official treaties," Mr Khanal said.

The search for the treaty papers began in 2016 after Nepal and India launched talks to review or replace the 1950 Treaty of Peace and Friendship.

The Nepali side wanted to examine the original copy of the treaty, but could not locate it. So, the government gave the committee reviewing the treaty a second copy instead.

On 22 July, the National Assembly's Delegated Legislation and Governance Committee said it had searched archives, libraries, museums, and relevant government departments but couldn't find the original copy of either the Sugauli Treaty or the 1950 Treaty.

Nepal (Getty)

Relations between India and Nepal have grown tense lately as the new Balendra Shah government in Kathmandu has ramped up rhetoric against Delhi over the border dispute.

The long-running territorial dispute is centred on Kalapani, Limpiyadhura and Lipulekh areas in the far west of Nepal. Kathmandu says these are Nepali territories under the 1816 treaty, which sets the Kali river, also known as Mahakali, as the boundary.

The core disagreement is over where the river begins, with the rivals relying on different historical maps and interpretations.

Tensions flared after Delhi and Beijing agreed to reopen the disputed Lipulekh trade route to resume the traditional Kailash-Mansarovar pilgrimage.

Mr Shah fanned the flames by claiming that Nepal had encroached on Indian territory, a departure from the usual stance of accusing its bigger neighbour of occupying the Himalayan nation's land. "You will be surprised to know a fact that I have learned recently, only after becoming prime minister. Not only has India encroached Nepali territory, but Nepal has also encroached Indian territory in many places," the new leader said in his first formal address to the parliament.

title: US Implements Cultural Property Agreement with Nepal - Ratopati
description: US Implements Cultural Property Agreement with Nepal  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. A cultural property agreement between Nepal and America has come into effect.

With the implementation of this agreement, the US government's significant contribution is expected to prevent illegal theft, smuggling, and illicit transfer of Nepal's invaluable cultural and historical heritage.

The US has maintained import restrictions on archaeological and ethnographic materials from Nepal, implementing the cultural property agreement signed between Nepal and the US in Poush 2082. According to the US Embassy in Nepal, this restriction is believed to play an important role in controlling the illegal trafficking of ancient artifacts, idols, and cultural objects rightfully owned by Nepal.

With the new restrictions in place, archaeological items illegally taken from Nepal will be stopped at US customs and it will be easier to return them safely to Nepal. The embassy has stated that the US is fully committed to the security of Nepal's invaluable cultural heritage. The objective of this agreement is to enable Nepali citizens as well as American tourists visiting Nepal to experience and observe these cultural heritages in their original form within Nepal, the embassy stated.

At a time when the return of stolen ancient artifacts from Nepal from various countries has been increasing in recent years, this strict policy of the US is believed to have provided significant assistance in the campaign against cultural property smuggling. Such agreements break illicit trafficking networks, prevent American collectors and museums from unknowingly purchasing stolen items, and stop financial flows towards terrorists and transnational criminals.

It is said that this also ensures that American citizens can responsibly access and study global heritage and plays a role in strengthening relations between US embassies and partner countries. According to the US Embassy, with 30 such agreements completed and implemented worldwide, the US is understood to be leading in cultural heritage preservation.

काठमांडू। नेपाल आ अमेरिकाक बीच सांस्कृतिक सम्पत्ति समझौता लागू भेल अछि ।

ई समझौता केरऽ कार्यान्वयन स॑ अमेरिकी सरकार केरऽ महत्वपूर्ण योगदान स॑ नेपाल केरऽ अमूल्य सांस्कृतिक आरू ऐतिहासिक धरोहर केरऽ अवैध चोरी, तस्करी, आरू अवैध स्थानांतरण क॑ रोकै के उम्मीद छै ।

अमेरिका नेपाल सँ पुरातात्विक आ नृवंशविज्ञान सामग्री पर आयात प्रतिबंध कायम रखने अछि, पौश २०८२ मे नेपाल आ अमेरिका के बीच हस्ताक्षरित सांस्कृतिक संपत्ति समझौता के लागू केलक अछि ।नेपाल मे अमेरिकी दूतावास के अनुसार ई प्रतिबंध नेपाल के सही स्वामित्व वाला प्राचीन वस्तु, मूर्ति, आ सांस्कृतिक वस्तु के अवैध तस्करी पर नियंत्रण में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाबैत मानल जाइत अछि ।

नव प्रतिबंध लागू भेला स नेपाल स अवैध तरीका स लेल गेल पुरातात्विक सामान कए अमेरिकी सीमा शुल्क मे रोकल जाएत आ ओकरा सुरक्षित रूप स नेपाल वापस करब आसान भ जाएत। दूतावास नेपाल के अमूल्य सांस्कृतिक धरोहर के सुरक्षा के लेल अमेरिका पूर्ण रूप स प्रतिबद्ध अछि से कहलक अछि । ई समझौता के उद्देश्य नेपाल के नागरिक के साथ-साथ नेपाल आबै वाला अमेरिकी पर्यटक सब के नेपाल के भीतर ई सांस्कृतिक धरोहर के मूल रूप में अनुभव आरू अवलोकन करै में सक्षम बनाबै के दूतावास के कहना छै ।

जे समय हाल के वर्षो में विभिन्न देश स नेपाल स चोरी के प्राचीन वस्तु के वापसी बढ़ि रहल अछि, ओहि समय में अमेरिका के ई सख्त नीति स सांस्कृतिक संपत्ति के तस्करी के खिलाफ अभियान में काफी सहायता भेटल मानल जाइत अछि। ऐन्हऽ समझौता स॑ अवैध तस्करी केरऽ नेटवर्क टूटी जाय छै, अमेरिकी संग्रहकर्ता आरू संग्रहालय क॑ अनजाने म॑ चोरी केरऽ सामान खरीदै स॑ रोकै छै, आरू आतंकवादी आरू ट्रांसनेशनल अपराधी के तरफ आर्थिक प्रवाह बंद होय जाय छै ।

कहलऽ जाय छै कि ई स॑ ई भी सुनिश्चित होय छै कि अमेरिकी नागरिक वैश्विक धरोहर क॑ जिम्मेदारी स॑ पहुँची सकै छै आरू ओकरऽ अध्ययन करी सक॑ आरू अमेरिकी दूतावास आरू भागीदार देशऽ के बीच संबंध क॑ मजबूत करै म॑ भूमिका निभाबै छै । अमेरिकी दूतावास के अनुसार, दुनिया भर मँ 30 ऐसनौ समझौता पूरा करी क लागू करलौ गेलौ छै, जेकरा सँ अमेरिका सांस्कृतिक धरोहर संरक्षण मँ अग्रणी समझलौ जाय रहलौ छै ।

title: Nepal-Delhi charas trail: How social media, bike taxis and autorickshaws helped move drugs - The Hindu
description: Nepal-Delhi charas trail: How social media, bike taxis and autorickshaws helped move drugs  The Hindu
publisher.title: The Hindu
full_article:
From the Nepal border to a bulk storage point in Wazirabad and then into the hands of local distributors, an international charas network had built a supply chain designed to keep the drugs moving while keeping those behind it out of sight.

Delhi Police’s South District police dismantled part of the network, arresting four Nepalese nationals and recovering 106.250 kg of high-quality charas estimated to be worth around ₹109 crore in an operation that stretched nearly 1.5 months.

Editorial | Caught in the middle: On India and curbing drug abuse

The operation began with a relatively small recovery of 8.598 kg at a residence in Kotla Mubarakpur on June 29 this year, leading to the arrest of Bharat Thapa, 32, Govind Budha, 32, and Jyoti Pun Magar, 50. Interrogation, technical surveillance, financial analysis and local intelligence eventually led the police to Roshni Magar, 32, who was operating a massive storage and distribution unit in Wazirabad.

A raid on the premises on August 12 led to the recovery of 97.652 kg of high-quality charas packed in 13 plastic bags. A mixing machine and packing material were also recovered.

A pictorial representation of how the international network operated. Photo Credit: Special Arrangement

Investigators revealed that the network sourced charas through suppliers in Nepal, including the Kakri area of Rukum, and moved it towards Delhi through the Sonauli border. The syndicate relied on road transportation to move the consignments to evade checks and reduce the chances of detection.

Who is Virender Singh Basoya? The mastermind of multi-crore drug syndicate extradited from UAE

Once the contraband reached Delhi, they were stored at various locations, packed into smaller packets based on the demand before being distributed further. Orders were coordinated through social media platforms including Telegram, with payments made both in cash and through digital banking channels. After transactions, the accused deleted digital communications to conceal their activities.

The drugs were then moved through local transport, including autorickshaws and bike taxis, to distributors and customers. Police said the network specifically targeted areas with a high concentration of younger people and demand centres such as Wazirabad and Majnu Ka Tila, with suspected supplies to distributors and customers linked to pubs, bars and hotels in the vicinity.

All you need to know about: drug addiction

According to DCP (South District) Anant Mittal, the syndicate has been in operation in Delhi for the past four to five years. Roshni had previously been part of the distribution network involving Thapa, Budha and Jyoti Pun Magar. After the three were arrested in June, she left India and returned to Nepal. Investigators said she recently came back to India believing that the situation had settled and resumed her operations.

The investigation has also opened up the Nepal end of the network. Binmaya, a Nepalese national, has emerged as an alleged key source who arranged transportation of charas from the Sonauli border towards Delhi. Another Nepalese national, Hari, has also emerged as an alleged supplier. Their exact roles, whereabouts and financial links are being established.

Police are now examining the financial trail to determine how money moved through the network and identify other people who may have financed, supplied, transported or distributed the drugs

दिल्ली पुलिस केरऽ दक्षिण जिला पुलिस न॑ नेटवर्क केरऽ कुछ हिस्सा क॑ तोड़ी क॑ चारो नेपाली नागरिक क॑ गिरफ्तार करी क॑ लगभग डेढ़ महीना तलक चलै वाला अभियान म॑ १०६.२५० किलो उच्च गुणवत्ता वाला चरा बरामद करी लेलकै जेकरऽ कीमत लगभग १०९ करोड़ रुपया के अनुमान छै ।

सम्पादकीय | बीच मे फंसल : भारत आ नशा पर लगाम लगेबा पर

एहि साल 29 जून कए कोटला मुबारकपुर क एकटा आवास पर 8.598 किलो वजन क अपेक्षाकृत कम बरामदगी स शुरू भेल एहि अभियान क शुरुआत 32 वर्षीय भारत थापा, 32 वर्षीय गोविंद बुढ़ा आ 50 वर्षीय ज्योति पुन मगर कए गिरफ्तार कैल गेल। 32, जे वजीराबाद मे एकटा पैघ भंडारण आ वितरण इकाई संचालित क रहल छलाह।

12 अगस्त कए परिसर मे छापामारी मे 13 प्लास्टिक क थैली मे पैक कैल गेल 97.652 किलो उच्च गुणवत्ता वाला चरा बरामद भेल। एकटा मिक्सिंग मशीन आ पैकिंग मटेरियल सेहो बरामद कायल गेल।

अंतर्राष्ट्रीय नेटवर्क कोना संचालित होइत छल तकर चित्रात्मक प्रतिनिधित्व । फोटो साभार : विशेष व्यवस्था

जांचकर्ता के पता चलल अछि जे नेटवर्क रुकुम के काकरी इलाका सहित नेपाल मे आपूर्तिकर्ता के माध्यम सं चरा के सोर्सिंग करैत सोनौली सीमा सं दिल्ली दिस ल गेल छल. सिंडिकेशन सड़क परिवहन पर निर्भर छल जे चेक स बचबा लेल आ पता लगेबाक संभावना कए कम करबा लेल खेप कए स्थानांतरित करि देल जाए।

वीरेन्द्र सिंह बसोया के छथि ? यूएई स प्रत्यर्पण बहु करोड़ ड्रग सिंडिकेशन क मास्टरमाइंड

एक बेर कांट्राबैंड दिल्ली पहुंचला पर विभिन्न स्थान पर संग्रहित क देल गेल, मांग क आधार पर छोट-छोट पैकेट मे पैक क आगू बांटल गेल। टेलीग्राम सहित सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म क माध्यम स ऑर्डर क समन्वय कैल गेल, जाहि मे भुगतान नकद आ डिजिटल बैंकिंग चैनल क माध्यम स दूनू कैल गेल। लेनदेन के बाद आरोपी अपन गतिविधि के नुकेबाक लेल डिजिटल संचार के डिलीट क देलक।

एकर बाद ऑटोरिक्शा आ बाइक टैक्सी सहित स्थानीय परिवहन क माध्यम स एहि दवाई कए वितरक आ ग्राहक तक पहुंचाउल गेल। पुलिस के कहनाय अछि जे ई नेटवर्क विशेष रूप सं ओहि इलाका के लक्षित केलक अछि जतय युवा लोक के बेसी एकाग्रता आ वजीराबाद आ मजनू का तिला सन डिमांड सेंटर छल, जाहि मे वितरक आ ग्राहक के संदिग्ध आपूर्ति आसपास के पब, बार आ होटल सं जुड़ल छल.

अहां के बस एतबे जानय के जरूरत अछि: नशा के लत

डीसीपी (दक्षिण जिला) अनंत मित्तल क अनुसार दिल्ली मे पिछला चारि स पांच साल स इ सिन्डिकेट संचालित अछि। रोशनी पहिने थापा, बुढ़ा आ ज्योति पुन मगर स जुड़ल वितरण नेटवर्क क हिस्सा रहल छलीह। जून मे तीनू गोटे के गिरफ्तार के बाद ओ भारत छोड़ि नेपाल वापस आबि गेलीह. जांचकर्ता के कहनाय छनि जे हाल मे ओ ई मानैत भारत वापस आबि गेल छलीह जे स्थिति ठीक भ गेल अछि आओर फेर सं हुनकर ऑपरेशन शुरू भ गेल अछि.

जांच सं नेटवर्क के नेपाल छोर सेहो खुलल अछि. सोनौली सीमा स दिल्ली दिस चरा क परिवहन क व्यवस्था करय वाला कथित प्रमुख स्रोत क रूप मे नेपाली नागरिक बिनमाया सामने आयल छथि। एकटा आओर नेपाली नागरिक हरि सेहो कथित आपूर्तिकर्ताक रूप मे उभरल अछि । हुनकऽ सटीक भूमिका, ठिकाना आरू आर्थिक संबंध स्थापित करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै ।

पुलिस आब वित्तीय निशान के जांच क रहल अछि जे नेटवर्क के माध्यम सं पैसा कोना चलैत छल आओर दोसर लोक के पहचान क रहल अछि जे ड्रग्स के वित्तपोषण, आपूर्ति, परिवहन या वितरण केने हेताह

title: Dissident NC leaders underscore unity in party to bolster democracy - risingnepaldaily.com
description: Dissident NC leaders underscore unity in party to bolster democracy  risingnepaldaily.com
publisher.title: risingnepaldaily.com
full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug 14: Nepali Congress leaders, dissatisfied with the establishment faction, have underscored the urgency of unity within party to bolster democracy.

Addressing the inaugural function of the national gathering they organized, the leaders mentioned that the NC's unity counts to resolve crisis and challenges before nationalism in the country.

Leader Dr Prakash Sharan Mahat compared the conduct of special general convention of NC with the Gen Z movement in the country. NC faced unexpected result in the election. He hoped the Supreme Court would cater justice to entire party.

Leader NP Saud said NC was in trouble after the special general convention was held hastily all because of ambitions of particular leaders. Mahalaxmi Upadhyay (Dina) argued contribution and struggle of senior leaders must be hailed to advance the party.

It was untimely conduct of special general convention that put party in trouble, according to Ramesh Lekhak. In view of Bir Bahadur Balayar, NC must not compromise BP's principles.

Other leaders addressing the event were Mohan Bahadur Basnet, Purnaman Tamang, Umakanta Chaudhary, Bhimsen Das Pradhan, Durlav Thapa, Rajesh Yadav, Mekhraj Shrestha, Gehendra Giri, Shiva Prasad Humagain, Uma Bhattarai, Guru Baral, Sita Rana, Padam Narayan Chaudhary, Dipak Khadka, Sarita Prasai, Rewati Bhusal, Raju Shrestha, Ganesh Timilsina and Jagat Baram. They stressed that NC must be united.

The national gathering organized by the Deuba group will continue for three days.

The event is being held at Miracle Party Venue at Sukedhara, Kathmandu. Event publicity committee coordinator Min Bahadur Bishwokarma informed that the gathering would have a closed session on Saturday and Sunday.(RSS)

अपनऽ आयोजन म॑ आयोजित राष्ट्रीय सभा के उद्घाटन समारोह क॑ संबोधित करतें हुअ॑ नेता सिनी न॑ ई बात के जिक्र करलकै कि देश म॑ राष्ट्रवाद स॑ पहल॑ संकट आरू चुनौती के समाधान लेली नेकां के एकता के गिनती छै ।

नेता डॉ. प्रकाश शरण महत नेकपा के विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन के संचालन के तुलना देश के जेन जेड आंदोलन स केलनि। चुनाव मे नेकपा के अप्रत्याशित परिणाम के सामना करय पड़ल. हुनका उम्मीद छल जे सुप्रीम कोर्ट पूरा पार्टी कए न्याय देत।

नेता एनपी साउद कहलनि जे, विशेष आम अधिवेशन जल्दबाजी मे आयोजित भेलाक बाद नेकपा परेशानी मे अछि सबटा नेता विशेष के महत्वाकांक्षा के कारण। महालक्ष्मी उपाध्याय (दीना) के तर्क छल जे पार्टी के आगू बढ़ेबा लेल वरिष्ठ नेता के योगदान आ संघर्ष के प्रशंसा करय पड़त।

विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन के असामयिक संचालन छल जे पार्टी के परेशानी में डाल देलक, रमेश लेखक के अनुसार। बीर बहादुर बलायर कए देखैत नेकपा कए बीपी क सिद्धांत स समझौता नहि करबाक चाही।

आयोजन के संबोधित करय वाला अन्य नेता मोहन बहादुर बस्नेत, पूर्णमन तामांग, उमाकांत चौधरी, भीमसेन दास प्रधान, दुर्लव थापा, राजेश यादव, मेखराज श्रेष्ठ, गेहेन्द्र गिरी, शिव प्रसाद हुमागैन, उमा भट्टराई, गुरु बरल, सीता राणा, पदम नारायण चौधरी, दिपक खडका, सरिता रहलाह प्रसाई, रेवती भुसाल, राजू श्रेष्ठ, गणेश तिमिलसिना एवं जगत बरम। ओ सब नेकपा के एकजुट होबय पड़त ताहि पर जोर देलनि।

देउबा समूह द्वारा आयोजित राष्ट्रीय सभा तीन दिन धरि चलत।

ई आयोजन काठमांडू के सुकेधारा स्थित चमत्कार पार्टी स्थल पर भ रहल अछि । आयोजन प्रचार समिति के संयोजक मिन बहादुर विश्वकर्मा शनि आ रवि दिन सभा के बंद सत्र होयत से जानकारी देलनि।(आरएसएस)

title: China Forced Nepal to Cancel an International Conference on Tibetan Studies - The Diplomat – Asia
description: China Forced Nepal to Cancel an International Conference on Tibetan Studies  The Diplomat – Asia
publisher.title: The Diplomat – Asia
full_article:
The 17th Seminar of the International Association for Tibetan Studies (IATS) Conference, scheduled to be held at Kathmandu University, Nepal, from August 23-29, was cancelled on August 5 and later shifted online . The cancellation was done by the organizers, at the formal request of the Nepali government.

The IATS conference is one of the premier academic forums for Tibetan culture, history, language and religion. The conference was set to bring together scholars from 40 countries , including India, China, and the United States – many of whom had already arranged and paid for costs to attend the conference in Kathmandu. The conference had been in planning for four years, as Nepal was selected to host the seminar in 2022. The abrupt cancellation of the conference on grounds of “security concerns” highlights both Beijing’s ironclad grip and bid to assert authority over Tibetan Buddhism.

The cancellation came after Chinese officials expressed concerns over pro-Tibet activists using the platform for demonstrations. Notably, Nepal’s security agencies had ruled out the possibility of a security threat to the event.

The pressure came not only from Chinese diplomats but, most remarkably, a religious figure. The Venerable Master Yinshun, former vice president of the Buddhist Association of China and a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC) and abbot of the Chinese Temple of Nepal, visited Nepal on July 29. Following his visit, combined with diplomatic efforts by Chinese Ambassador to Nepal Zhang Maoming, around a dozen scholars from the Tibetan Policy Institute in India withdrew their participation from the conference.

The cancellation of the conference is consistent with Beijing’s recent efforts to exert control over Nepal’s association with Tibetan Buddhism. This is seen in several pre-emptive and proactive measures taken by Beijing to curb Tibetan Buddhism’s influence in Nepal. Earlier this year, Zhang, China’s ambassador, warned the home minister of Nepal, Sudan Gurung, against any government-level participation by Nepal in the oath-taking ceremony of the penpa tshering held on May 27 in Dharamshala, India. The penpa tshering is the highest executive authority of the Central Tibetan Administration (CTA). Notably, the oath-taking ceremony was also attended by the 14th Dalai Lama.

The CTA functions as the government-in-exile for the Tibetan people globally. Around 91,000 Tibetans registered their vote for the 2026 elections that elected the penpa tshering across India, Nepal, Bhutan, Europe, the United States, and other parts of Asia and Africa. In a bid to delegitimize the elections and the support for the CTA, a Global Times editorial characterized the elections as illegal and the CTA as an illicit “separatist organization.”

These efforts are not unique to Nepal. China has accelerated its efforts seeking to control narratives and perceptions related to Tibet around the world. Beijing’s bid for control over Tibetan Buddhism in particular comes at a crucial time: the Dalai Lama is now 91 years old, and he has announced that his trust, the Gaden Phodrang, would have the sole authority in recognizing his future reincarnation. Beijing responded swiftly, maintaining that the selection of the Dalai Lama’s successor would be determined by Chinese law.

The succession of the 14th Dalai Lama poses a strategic challenge to China. The Himalayan landscape spanning across India and China has been the site of border disputes between India and China, most recently the Galwan clashes of 2020. Many locals of the Himalayan region in the states of Sikkim, Ladakh, and Arunachal Pradesh in India are adherents of the Tibetan strand of Buddhism. Notably the Dalai Lama celebrated his 91st birthday in Ladakh – a demonstration of the expanse of influence of the Tibetan strand of Buddhism over the Indian Himalayan landscape.

The long-established cultural traditions of the locals of the Himalayan region, along with their reverence and faith in the Dalai Lama, delegitimize Chinese claims of normative authority in dictating Tibetan Buddhist practices. China has consistently maintained that the next Dalai Lama will be born in Chinese territory as opposed to the 14th Dalai Lama’s declaration that the next Dalai Lama may be born in India.

In recent times, the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) has shown increased attention toward the management of monasteries in its bid to establish control over the Tibetan strand of Buddhism. The CCP has taken on a more intrusive role, as seen during Li Ganjie’s tour of Gansu and Sichuan earlier this year. Li heads the United Front Work Department (UFWD). During the tour, he emphasized legal, standardized management of Tibetan Buddhist institutions and the need for socialist principles to guide Tibetan Buddhism.

One of the primary tasks of the UFWD in China is to generate favorable receptions for Chinese policies not only domestically but also overseas. In this context, Li’s interest in the management of monasteries is geared toward enhancing the CCP’s control over perceptions of Tibetan Buddhism both at home and abroad.

In many ways, its attempts to control Tibetan Buddhism expose the CCP’s discomfort with religion in general. An increasing number of the urban middle class in China are turning to religious and spiritual practices. Following the COVID-19 pandemic, a growing number of individuals in China have been attracted to the sense of community that religion provides. Chinese Buddhist institutions are perceived by many as corrupt and criticized for excessive commercialization, whereas Tibetan Buddhism is viewed as more esoteric. This sentiment has grown over the years with the rise in cases of embezzlement and corruption in Chinese Buddhist monasteries and temples. A rising number of the younger population in China are attracted to the day to day practices in Tibetan Buddhism as a key to a more balanced lifestyle.

नेपाल के काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय में 23-29 अगस्त तक होबय वाला इंटरनेशनल एसोसिएशन फॉर तिब्बती स्टडीज (IATS) सम्मेलन के 17म गोष्ठी 5 अगस्त के रद्द भ गेल छल आ बाद में ऑनलाइन शिफ्ट भ गेल छल . रद्दीकरण आयोजक द्वारा, नेपाली सरकारक औपचारिक आग्रह पर कयल गेल अछि ।

आईएटीएस सम्मेलन तिब्बती संस्कृति, इतिहास, भाषा आरू धर्म केरऽ प्रमुख शैक्षणिक मंचऽ म॑ स॑ एक छै । सम्मेलन में भारत, चीन, आ अमेरिका सहित 40 देश के विद्वान सब के एक संग आबय के छल – जाहि में सं बहुतो गोटे काठमांडू में सम्मेलन में भाग लेबय के व्यवस्था आ खर्च के भुगतान क चुकल छलाह. सम्मेलन केरऽ योजना चारि साल स॑ छेलै, कैन्हेंकि नेपाल क॑ २०२२ म॑ ई गोष्ठी के मेजबानी लेली चुनलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।“सुरक्षा सरोकार” के आधार प॑ सम्मेलन केरऽ अचानक रद्द होना बीजिंग केरऽ लोहा केरऽ पकड़ आरू तिब्बती बौद्ध धर्म प॑ अधिकार केरऽ दावा दूनू क॑ उजागर करै छै ।

चीनी अधिकारी सिनी न॑ तिब्बत समर्थक कार्यकर्ता सिनी न॑ ई मंच के प्रदर्शन लेली इस्तेमाल करै प॑ चिंता व्यक्त करला के बाद ई रद्द करलऽ गेलऽ छै । उल्लेखनीय अछि जे नेपाल के सुरक्षा एजेंसी एहि आयोजन पर सुरक्षा खतरा के संभावना के खारिज क देने छल.

ई दबाव चीनी राजनयिकऽ के ही नै बल्कि सबसें उल्लेखनीय बात ई छेलै कि एगो धार्मिक हस्ती के तरफऽ स॑ भी आबी गेलऽ छेलै । चीन के बौद्ध संघ के पूर्व उपाध्यक्ष आरू चीनी जन राजनीतिक परामर्शदात्री सम्मेलन (सीपीपीसीसी) के राष्ट्रीय समिति के सदस्य आरू नेपाल के चीनी मंदिर के मठाधीश पूज्य मास्टर यिनशुन 29 जुलाई क॑ नेपाल के दौरा करलकै भारत मे संस्थान सम्मेलन स अपन भागीदारी वापस ल लेलक।

सम्मेलन रद्द करब बीजिंग केरऽ हाल केरऽ प्रयास के अनुरूप छै कि नेपाल केरऽ तिब्बती बौद्ध धर्म के साथ जुड़ाव प॑ नियंत्रण रखै के कोशिश करलऽ जाय । ई बात नेपाल म॑ तिब्बती बौद्ध धर्म केरऽ प्रभाव प॑ लगाम लगाबै लेली बीजिंग द्वारा करलऽ गेलऽ कईएक पूर्वाग्रही आरू सक्रिय उपायऽ म॑ देखलऽ जाय छै । एहि सालक शुरुआत मे चीनक राजदूत झांग नेपालक गृहमंत्री सूडान गुरुंग केँ भारतक धर्मशाला मे 27 मई केँ आयोजित पेनपा त्शेरिंगक शपथ ग्रहण समारोह मे नेपालक कोनो तरहक सरकारी स्तरीय भागीदारी सँ चेतावनी देलनि। पेनपा त्शेरिंग केंद्रीय तिब्बती प्रशासन (सीटीए) केरऽ सर्वोच्च कार्यकारी प्राधिकारी छेकै । उल्लेखनीय अछि जे शपथ ग्रहण समारोह मे 14म दलाई लामा सेहो शामिल छलाह।

सीटीए वैश्विक स्तर पर तिब्बती लोगऽ लेली निर्वासित सरकार के रूप म॑ काम करै छै । २०२६ केरऽ चुनाव लेली लगभग ९१,००० तिब्बती न॑ अपनऽ वोट दर्ज करलकै जेकरा म॑ पूरा भारत, नेपाल, भूटान, यूरोप, अमेरिका, आरू एशिया आरू अफ्रीका केरऽ अन्य भागऽ म॑ पेनपा त्शेरिंग के चुनाव करलऽ गेलै । चुनाव आरू सीटीए केरऽ समर्थन क॑ अवैध बनाबै के कोशिश म॑ ग्लोबल टाइम्स केरऽ एगो संपादकीय म॑ चुनाव क॑ गैरकानूनी आरू सीटीए क॑ गैरकानूनी “अलगाववादी संगठन” के रूप म॑ पेश करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

ई प्रयास नेपालक लेल विशिष्ट नहि अछि । चीन न॑ दुनिया भर म॑ तिब्बत स॑ जुड़लऽ कथ्य आरू धारणा प॑ नियंत्रण रखै के कोशिश म॑ अपनऽ प्रयास म॑ तेजी लानल॑ छै । खास करी क॑ तिब्बती बौद्ध धर्म प॑ नियंत्रण लेली बीजिंग केरऽ दावेदारी एगो महत्वपूर्ण समय म॑ आबी रहलऽ छै : दलाई लामा केरऽ उम्र अब॑ ९१ साल होय गेलऽ छै, आरू हुनी घोषणा करी देल॑ छै कि हुनकऽ भविष्य केरऽ पुनर्जन्म क॑ पहचानै के एकमात्र अधिकार हुनकऽ ट्रस्ट, गडेन फोड्रंग क॑ होतै । बीजिंग न॑ तेजी स॑ जवाब देलकै आरू कहलकै कि दलाई लामा केरऽ उत्तराधिकारी के चयन चीनी कानून स॑ तय करलऽ जैतै ।

14म दलाई लामा के उत्तराधिकार चीन के लेल रणनीतिक चुनौती अछि. भारत आरू चीन भर म॑ फैललऽ हिमालय केरऽ परिदृश्य भारत आरू चीन के बीच सीमा विवाद के स्थल रहलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ सबसें हाल म॑ २०२० केरऽ गलवान झड़प छेलै ।भारत केरऽ सिक्किम, लद्दाख, आरू अरुणाचल प्रदेश राज्यऽ के हिमालय क्षेत्र केरऽ बहुत सारा स्थानीय लोग बौद्ध धर्म केरऽ तिब्बती स्ट्रैंड के अनुयायी छै । उल्लेखनीय छै कि दलाई लामा न॑ लद्दाख म॑ अपनऽ ९१वां जन्मदिन मनाबै छेलै – जे भारतीय हिमालयी परिदृश्य प॑ बौद्ध धर्म केरऽ तिब्बती स्ट्रैंड केरऽ प्रभाव के विस्तार के प्रदर्शन छेलै ।

हिमालयी क्षेत्र के स्थानीय लोगऽ के लंबा समय स॑ स्थापित सांस्कृतिक परंपरा के साथ-साथ दलाई लामा के प्रति हुनकऽ श्रद्धा आरू विश्वास तिब्बती बौद्ध प्रथा के हुकुम लगाबै म॑ चीनी के मानक अधिकार के दावा क॑ वैधताहीन करी दै छै । चीन लगातार ई बात के कहना छै कि अगला दलाई लामा के जन्म चीनी इलाका म॑ होतै जेकरऽ विपरीत 14वां दलाई लामा केरऽ घोषणा छै कि अगला दलाई लामा के जन्म भारत म॑ होय सकै छै ।

हाल के समय म॑ चीनी कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी (सीसीपी) न॑ बौद्ध धर्म केरऽ तिब्बती स्ट्रैंड प॑ नियंत्रण स्थापित करै के कोशिश म॑ मठऽ के प्रबंधन के तरफ बढ़लऽ ध्यान देखैलकै । सीसीपी न॑ आरू घुसपैठिया भूमिका निभैल॑ छै, जैसनऽ कि ई साल केरऽ शुरुआत म॑ ली गंजी केरऽ गांसू आरू सिचुआन केरऽ दौरा के दौरान देखलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । ली संयुक्त मोर्चा कार्य विभाग (यूएफडब्ल्यूडी) के प्रमुख छैथ। भ्रमण के दौरान हुनी तिब्बती बौद्ध संस्थानऽ के कानूनी, मानकीकृत प्रबंधन आरू तिब्बती बौद्ध धर्म के मार्गदर्शन लेली समाजवादी सिद्धांतऽ के जरूरत प॑ जोर देलकै ।

चीन म॑ यूएफडब्ल्यूडी केरऽ एगो प्राथमिक काम चीनी नीति लेली न सिर्फ घरेलू स्तर प॑ बल्कि विदेशऽ म॑ भी अनुकूल स्वागत पैदा करना छै । ई संदर्भ म॑ मठऽ के प्रबंधन म॑ ली केरऽ रुचि देश आरू विदेश दूनू जगह प॑ तिब्बती बौद्ध धर्म केरऽ धारणा प॑ सीसीपी केरऽ नियंत्रण बढ़ाबै के दिशा म॑ छै ।

बहुत तरह स॑ तिब्बती बौद्ध धर्म प॑ नियंत्रण रखै के ओकरऽ प्रयास स॑ सीसीपी केरऽ सामान्य रूप स॑ धर्म के प्रति असुविधा के खुलासा होय छै । चीन केरऽ शहरी मध्यम वर्ग केरऽ बढ़तऽ संख्या धार्मिक आरू आध्यात्मिक प्रथा के तरफ रुख करी रहलऽ छै । कोविड-19 महामारी के बाद चीन में बढ़ैत संख्या में व्यक्ति के ओहि समुदाय के भाव के प्रति आकर्षित कयल गेल अछि जे धर्म प्रदान करैत अछि | चीनी बौद्ध संस्थान क॑ बहुत लोगऽ द्वारा भ्रष्ट मानलऽ जाय छै आरू अत्यधिक व्यावसायिकरण के कारण आलोचना करलऽ जाय छै, जबकि तिब्बती बौद्ध धर्म क॑ अधिक गूढ़ मानलऽ जाय छै । चीनी बौद्ध मठ आरू मंदिरऽ म॑ गबन आरू भ्रष्टाचार के मामला बढ़ला के साथ ई भावना वर्षो स॑ बढ़ी गेलऽ छै । चीन केरऽ बढ़तऽ संख्या म॑ युवा आबादी तिब्बती बौद्ध धर्म म॑ रोजमर्रा के प्रथा के तरफ आकर्षित होय रहलऽ छै जे अधिक संतुलित जीवनशैली के कुंजी छै ।

title: Gorkhas rise up in Nepal: Demand return to Indian Army | Gravitas - WION
description: Gorkhas rise up in Nepal: Demand return to Indian Army | Gravitas  WION
publisher.title: WION
full_article:
A historic military tradition between India and Nepal is facing an uncertain future. Gorkha veterans are reportedly demanding that Kathmandu clears the way for Nepali youths to join the Indian Army again. According to a Nepali news portal in the central Nepalese city of Pokhara, former Gorkha soldiers and their supporters took to the streets calling for recruitment to resume under India's Agnipath scheme.



The protest was reportedly organised by the Indian ex-servicemen Gorkha brigade Nepal Pokhara. It also comes just days before Indian Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth is scheduled to visit Nepal. According to the Nepalese news portal, the group submitted a two-point memorandum to Nepal's federal government through the district administration office. They are demanding the immediate restart of recruitment. The protesters reportedly say the recruitment freeze has cost Nepali youths an important employment opportunity while putting a centuries-old military tradition at risk.



Nepali youths have been recruited into the Indian Army for more than two centuries following a treaty signed between the British East India Company and the Kingdom of Nepal in 1816. After India's Independence in 1947, six Gorkha regiments of the British Indian Army became part of the Indian Army under a tripartite agreement involving India, Nepal and Britain. They are said to be the fiercest fighters on the planet. Ferocious warriors who can guarantee you a win. Famous for their slouch hats and curved kukri knives, they have served many armies, fought multiple battles and won numerous awards both under British rule and the Indian Army.

The recruitment pipeline was disrupted around 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic. After India introduced the Agnipath scheme in 2022, Nepal asked India to hold off on recruiting Nepali Gorkhas, citing concerns about the new system and the future of soldiers after their four-year tenure. Under the Agnipath scheme, recruits known as Agniveers serve for four years, with up to 25 percent eligible for longer service. The Indian Armed Forces are reportedly seeking to increase that retention share. However, Gorkha veterans say the scheme could still provide young Nepalis with a better alternative to overseas employment.

Their memorandum, cited by ratopati, says recruits can earn roughly 4.5 to 5 million Nepali rupees over four years with benefits. It contrasts that with low-paid jobs in the gulf where workers can face temperatures approaching 50 degrees Celsius. That gulf comparison is central to the veterans' argument. They say military service offers Nepali youths a more secure and dignified option than dangerous, poorly paid work abroad.

title: Nepal, India set three-year deadline to map cross-border land occupation - The Kathmandu Post
description: Nepal, India set three-year deadline to map cross-border land occupation  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
In a major breakthrough, senior survey officials from Nepal and India have agreed to conclude the mapping of cross border occupation, a long-standing boundary issue between the two countries, within three years.

The 13th meeting of the Survey Officials' Committee (SOC), which concluded in Lucknow, India on Friday, agreed to determine the exact status of land occupation across the boundary with technological assistance.

“We have decided to use unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) to conclude mapping of cross border occupation in three years,” Susheel Dangol, deputy director at Department of Survey, told the Post over the phone from Lucknow. Dangol was leading the talks from the Nepal side.

The issue of cross-border occupation came into the spotlight after Prime Minister Balendra Shah told parliament in late May that, after assuming office, he learned that “not only has India encroached on Nepal’s land, but Nepal has also encroached on India’s land in multiple places.”

Later, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs clarified that Shah’s reference to Nepal having encroached on Indian land referred to the cross-border occupation and use of land, rather than to any territorial claim.

When the Nepal-India border was delineated, the Fixed Boundary Principle was adopted in riverine areas, resulting in situations of “cross-border occupation”, where citizens of one country cultivate and reside on land falling within the territory of the other country.

Over the decades, changes in the courses of hundreds of rivers have shifted thousands of hectares of land from one side of the border to the other. The SOC and the Joint Field Survey Teams are currently documenting these changes, and their findings will provide the technical basis for future decisions by the two governments, according to the officials.

When the 182 sets of strip maps were signed between Nepal and India in 2007, it was identified that nationals from both countries had either cultivated or resided on hundreds of hectares of land belonging to citizens of the other country.

“The UAVs will capture aerial images for the survey. We will then analyse those images and reach a common understanding to determine the extent of cross-border occupation,” said Dangol. He said the three-day meeting also approved the annual plan and budget for implementing the agreement.

Both the sides will start the joint survey soon after the monsoon season ends, around September or October.

The SOC is a subordinate committee of the Boundary Working Group (BWG), which is led by the heads of the survey departments of the two countries.

In its 2025 meeting, the BWG agreed to complete technical boundary work—including the joint construction of new boundary pillars and repair of damaged ones—within three years, except in the Susta and Kalapani-Limpiyadhura-Lipulekh areas.

Bilateral efforts to resolve technical boundary issues date back further, particularly to Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s state visit to Nepal in 2014.

During the visit, the two sides agreed to establish the BWG, giving it a mandate to clear no-man’s land, construct, restore, and repair boundary pillars, update records of cross-border property holdings, and undertake other technical tasks related to border management.

According to the Department of Survey, 8,554 boundary pillars have been installed along the Nepal-India border. Of these, 1,325 are missing, while 1,956 are either partially or completely damaged. Under the BWG framework, the SOC and Joint Field Survey Teams provide technical expertise and carry out field-level work.

In 2015, the two sides set a three-year deadline to complete the technical work. After missing that target, they renewed the deadline in 2017, aiming to finish the work by 2022. That deadline also lapsed due to a combination of factors, including funding constraints, the Covid pandemic, recurring boundary disputes and adverse climatic conditions. Nepal and India share a 1,880-kilometre border spanning 27 districts.

title: Over 20,000 complaints related to cybercrime registered; 155 accused held - risingnepaldaily.com
description: Over 20,000 complaints related to cybercrime registered; 155 accused held  risingnepaldaily.com
publisher.title: risingnepaldaily.com
full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug 14: A total of 20,526 complaints related to cybercrime have been registered at the police office from mid-July 2025 (Nepali Fiscal Year 2082/83) to mid-July 2026 (2083/84).

In the reporting period, 161 cases of cybercrime were filed, and 155 people were arrested.

Among the registered complaints, 7,123 were related to misuse of Facebook/Messenger, 6,776 for TikTok, 3,105 for WhatsApp, 1,031 for Telegram, 628 for Instagram, 114 for email, 21 for Viber, 38 for Imo, 64 for YouTube, 14 for WeChat, 11 for Twitter, 11 for Google, 744 for eSewa/Khalti/bank accounts/SMS, and 846 related to organizations.

During the fiscal year 2081/82, total 18,926 complaints were registered while 19,730 complaints related to cybercrime were filed with the police in the Fiscal Year 2080/81.

In regard to the recent trends in cybercrime, Superintendent of Police (SP) Dilip Kumar Giri, also the spokesperson at the Cyber Bureau, said that with the use of social media, its misuse is also increasing.

According to him, looking at the trend of complaints in the last two fiscal years, there has been an increase in scams such as accessing victims' bank accounts through banks and wallet offices under false pretenses, scamming people by claiming gifts, lotteries, and parcels, deceiving through romantic relationships, luring with promises of foreign employment, scamming via online job offers on Telegram, WhatsApp, and Instagram, and scamming in the name of online shopping.

Due to the misuse of technology, new types and trends of crime are emerging, making criminal investigations even more challenging.

To face such challenges and to prevent and successfully investigate technology-based crimes, the Government of Nepal established the Cyber Bureau on 10 June 2018.

The Bureau has been increasingly equipped with technology, enhancing police personnel’s capacity in cybercrime and security, as well as running various programmes to raise cyber security awareness among the general public.

The Nepal Police remains active in preventing and investigating crimes committed through the use of technology. (RSS)

ब्यूरो क॑ तेजी स॑ तकनीक स॑ लैस करलऽ गेलऽ छै, जेकरा स॑ साइबर अपराध आरू सुरक्षा म॑ पुलिस कर्मी केरऽ क्षमता बढ़ी गेलऽ छै, साथ ही साथ आम जनता म॑ साइबर सुरक्षा के प्रति जागरूकता पैदा करै लेली विभिन्न कार्यक्रम चलाबै के काम करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

तकनीक के प्रयोग स भेल अपराध के रोकथाम आ जांच में नेपाल पुलिस सक्रिय अछि। (आर एस एस) २.
